provenance.notes: Retired: the 2024 Cub Scout Leader Book describes a single den leader / assistant den leader role, and the June 2025 CS19 Position Trained Requirements lists only Den Leader & Assistant Den Leader - the Tiger/Webelos-specific den-leader positions are gone.

discontinued.reason: The 2024 Cub Scout program consolidated the rank-specific den-leader positions into a single Cub Scout Den Leader and Assistant Den Leader; this position is retired.
